title: Sigil and Ember
author: Jonah Hartwell
blurb: Mara Quintana, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
